purpose: Original demonstration project cover for Segundo Cérebro
modifications: None. Original generated PNG copied without resampling or editing.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photographic project cover for a calm personal knowledge workspace, source bitmap image only.
Primary request: an original editorial photograph of a cozy study arrangement: one open book, a short stack of books with plain covers, and simple paper catching soft natural window light.
Scene/backdrop: an understated warm study surface with a small subtle hint of muted green in the background; intimate and quiet, with clean spacing and carefully observed materials.
Style/medium: sophisticated realistic editorial photography, natural paper texture and gentle optical depth; modern and minimal, no illustration or interface.
Composition/framing: extra-wide panoramic horizontal image, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. Book and paper subjects stay in the central band and remain recognizable with desktop and mobile cover cropping. Close oblique perspective, visually distinct from a laptop workspace.
Lighting/mood: soft natural daylight with a delicate reflected glow on the paper, relaxed thoughtful atmosphere.
Color palette: cream, warm neutral beige, muted paper white, light brown with discreet soft green accents.
Constraints: no visible book titles, readable text or markings; use blank pages or completely indistinct page texture. No people, hands, laptops, logos, watermarks, icons, buttons, borders, UI or interface chrome. No clutter. Do not include a mockup frame.
inspection: Visually inspected: natural editorial photography; calm neutral palette; recognizable central subject; no readable text, brand logos, people, icons, interface chrome or watermark.
